 Ella Stiller Reveals How Her Career in Cupertino Differs from Her Parents' Paths
 Parade Follow Laura Clark Add to Preferred Sources Sat, November 7, 2026 at 8:14 PM UTC Ella Stiller Reveals How Her Career in Cupertino Differs from Her Parents' Paths Ella Stiller might be the daughter and granddaughter of Hollywood heavyweights, but she's making a career move that's all her own.
 The 24-year-old actress, whose parents are Ben Stiller and Christine Taylor (and grandparents are the late Jerry Stiller and Anne Meara ), stars in CBS' new legal drama Cupertino , a 20-episode series that takes place in the cutthroat tech world of Silicon Valley.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While her parents are known for films including Zoolander , Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story , as well as Ben's Apple TV streaming series Severance , Ella is now making her mark in network television.
 "It's so separate from my parents. We've never had much crossover on work stuff," she told Elite Daily . "But they're so thrilled for me and love the show."
 She added that it's "always been natural" for her to do her own thing.
 "Learning from my parents has been incredible, but in general as a human being, I don't like to follow any set path," the actress said.
 In Cupertino , Ella plays legal assistant Christy Palladino, who starts a flirtation with a man named Bo who turns out to be created from artificial intelligence.
 Advertisement Advertisement "Christy and Bo definitely have a real connection, and it evolves into something more serious rather than just fun and flirty. But I have my own theory about what's going on there," the Juilliard graduate told the outlet. "I think Bo knows that flirting with Christy is his best tactic to get the law firm's attention."
 While the series delves into the moral complexities of AI, Ella has strong opinions about the technology.
 "I'm not super into tech stuff, but I'm very, very passionate about how AI is a real danger to humanity, especially in the arts," she said. "Art comes from being a person. Artists are people who feel so deeply, and computers can't do that."
 More to explore
 Cupertino isn't Ella's first series. She also appeared in HBO reboots The Comeback , as a Gen Z social media specialist to Lisa Kudrow 's Valerie Cherish, as well as And Just Like That… , as a woman who becomes pregnant with Miranda's grandchild.
